Calculation Methodology

Net Creator Revenue = Sale Price - (Sale Price × 10% Gumroad Fee) - $0.50 - (Sale Price × 2.9% + $0.30 Card Fee).

Reference Notes & FAQ

Did Gumroad become a Merchant of Record?

Yes, Gumroad handles global tax collection on digital sales, charging a 10% + $0.50 platform fee plus standard payment processor fees.

How much do Gumroad Discover sales cost?

Sales generated organically through Gumroad Discover carry a 30% total fee instead of the standard direct-link fee.
